pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane White Ninja Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane, the White Ninja, appears in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, shown close up with a diamond-shaped mask crest and shoulder guards beside his face. Two round emblems decorate the wrap-front uniform below his focused eyes. Bold outlines and simple rectangular background patterns create clear sections around the armored portrait.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane with Shurikens of Ice Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane holds the Shurikens of Ice in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising one pointed weapon beside his head and lowering the other across his waist. Faceted ice crystals rise behind the minifigure's legs. The angular blades, circular grips, folded mask, belt buckle, and tied sash supply distinct details throughout the stance.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Using Ice Powers Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane uses ice powers in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, extending both hands as tall crystal clusters fan outward from his curved palms on each side. His masked face and simple wrap-front uniform remain centered between the pointed shards. A tied sash and block-shaped feet provide broad shapes beneath the sharp ice facets.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Performing Ice Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane performs ice Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising one arm as curved energy bands and floating crystals spiral around his minifigure body. A snowflake decorates his forehead crest, with another on the uniform beside a dragon emblem. Angular ice pieces contrast with the sweeping ribbons of the vortex.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Zx Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane ZX holds a shuriken in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing before a simple gateway amid hanging icicles and irregular frozen shapes around the entrance. His crested mask and shoulder guards frame the focused eyes. Round chest emblems, uniform fastenings, a tied sash, and block feet add detail to the icy setting.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Ninja Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane's ninja mask dominates this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with focused eyes beneath a tall central crest and layered curved folds across the covered mouth. A small portion of the wrap-front collar appears below. Thick contours, large forehead sections, and the plain background keep this close-up portrait simple and clearly outlined.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Titanium Zane Coloring Page
pages.description: Titanium Zane stands facing forward in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a crested mask and broad segmented shoulder guards above a dragon-shaped chest emblem. Crossed straps and a small sword motif decorate the torso. The tied sash and large rectangular legs offer open sections beneath the more detailed upper-body armor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Nindroid Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane appears as a Nindroid in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with an uncovered flat-topped hairstyle, a circular mechanical eye, and an outlined jaw panel. Gears, pipes, and angular armor shapes pattern his torso beneath one shoulder guard. Rivets, a belt buckle, and simple geometric background accents reinforce the mechanical design.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane with Elemental Blade Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane holds an Elemental Blade in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, gripping its wrapped handle as the long curved sword crosses diagonally before his mask. A double circular border frames his upper body. Broad uniform panels, the angular sword guard, and a knotted sash create clear areas within the simple character emblem.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane Ice Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane appears as an ice robot in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing large angular armor and holding a broad sword across his mechanical legs. Snowflakes float above crystal clusters at his feet. Segmented arms, visible joints, chest panels, and a masked head create a detailed mix of rectangular and pointed shapes.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane in Temple of Light Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane stands in the Temple of Light in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a tall decorated sword before a doorway topped with elemental symbols. A pointed arch surrounds the entrance, with small brick outlines on either side. His crossed straps, chest panels, shoulder guards, tied sash, and leg wraps supply costume details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane in Ignacia Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane visits Ignacia in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, shown before rows of curved-roof buildings with distant mountains and small trees rising above the street. A round emblem fastens the straps across his torso. His folded mask, shoulder guards, curved hands, and knotted belt keep the ninja prominent against the village setting.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane in Monastery Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane stands in a monastery courtyard in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with snowflake emblems on his chest and a sword handle rising behind one shoulder. A tiled gateway, hanging lanterns, shaped tree, and distant pagoda fill the background. Armor fastenings, leg wraps, and the grid of paving provide smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane in Skull Sorcerer Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane explores the Skull Sorcerer Mine in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, carrying a pointed shuriken among crystals, rocky walls, and tracks leading through the cave. Skull-shaped decorations hang above him and mark a mine cart. His shoulder armor, chest emblem, and tied sash contrast with the angular underground formations.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Zane in Never Realm Coloring Page
pages.description: Zane appears in the Never Realm in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising a sword near his shoulder beneath a broad hood and folded face covering. Snowflakes and small ice fragments float around the rocky frozen landscape. Crossed armor straps, a dragon medallion, segmented chest panels, and a knotted sash add costume detail.
